raw_html: [[Telekinetic#Epic Telekinetic|Epic Telekinetic]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Telekinetic#Epic Telekinetic|Epic Telekinetic]]:''' Targets that suffer a critical hit from a Telekinetic weapon must make a DC 35 Strength or Dexterity check or be knocked down. The target will then be forced to make DC 16 [[Balance]] checks to recover from this effect.
